title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the magnetic field is zero for r < a.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the magnetic field within the conductor for a < r < b.

title: Final Answer (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the expression for the magnetic field outside the conductor for r > b.

title: Current Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct expression for the current density j in the conductor.

title: Current Enclosed Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the current I(r) enclosed by a radius r for a < r < b.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply symmetry arguments appropriately to justify the use of Ampère's law.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for the magnetic field.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expressions for the magnetic field.
